Three Generations,
One Standard 三代传承，同一坚持

The Rivera family has worked Nicaraguan tobacco since 1970. Today's blends pair Estelí-grown leaf with Cuban-seed genetics, rolled in small batches under the same standard the family has held for three generations.

里维拉家族自1970年起深耕尼加拉瓜烟草种植。如今的配方融合埃斯特利烟叶与古巴种源基因，延续三代人坚持的小批量手工卷制标准。

Craftsmanship · 工艺传承

Rolled by Hand,
Boxed with Intent 手工卷制，用心装箱

Every cigar passes through the same torcedores' hands from leaf selection to final roll, then rests before it's boxed — Allied Glory's regional customers receive the same small-batch standard sold in Estelí.

每支雪茄均由同一批卷烟师从选叶到成型手工完成，静置陈化后方才装箱——匯朗科技在大中华及东南亚地区交付的，是与埃斯特利本地完全一致的小批量标准。

  • Hand-selected Nicaraguan long-filler & binder
  • Four wrapper origins: Connecticut, Habano, Indonesia, Maduro
  • Individually cellophaned, ribbon-finished presentation
  • Private-label & custom box branding available on order
